smart_manufacturing.title: Smart Manufacturing
smart_manufacturing.description: Transform your factory with intelligent automation. Our collaborative robotss, AMRs, and AI vision systems work alongside your workforce to increase productivity, quality, and flexibility.

applications.name: Assembly & Kitting
applications.description: Collaborative robots handle repetitive assembly tasks with high precision, freeing human workers for higher-value activities. collaborative robots C2 and C5 models are ideal for electronics, automotive, and consumer goods assembly lines.

applications.name: Quality Inspection
applications.description: AI-powered vision systems automatically detect defects, measure dimensions, and verify assembly correctness at production-line speeds. Our computer vision models achieve 99.7%+ defect detection rates in electronics manufacturing.

applications.name: Material Handling
applications.description: CarryBot A1 AMRs autonomously transport raw materials, work-in-progress, and finished goods between production cells, warehouses, and shipping areas — eliminating manual forklift operations.

applications.name: Machine Tending
applications.description: collaborative robots arms load and unload CNC machines, injection molding presses, and test equipment 24/7. Quick changeover between product variants through teach-by-demonstration programming.

applications.name: Packaging & Palletizing
applications.description: End-of-line automation with collaborative robots C5 for case packing and palletizing. Handles mixed-SKU pallets with AI-powered stacking optimization.

smart_manufacturing.case_study: A major electronics manufacturer deployed 12 CoBot C2 units and 8 CarryBot A1 AMRs across their PCB assembly line. Result: 40% throughput increase, 60% defect reduction, and ROI in 14 months.

healthcare.title: Healthcare & Medical
healthcare.description: Our healthcare robotics solutions improve hospital efficiency, reduce staff burden, and enhance patient care — from logistics automation to AI-assisted diagnostics.

applications.name: Hospital Logistics
applications.description: MediBot M1 automates medication delivery, lab sample transport, linen distribution, and meal delivery throughout hospital campuses. Integrates with HIS/EMR for automated task dispatching.

applications.name: Patient Assistance
applications.description: ServeBot S2 deployed in patient rooms and wards for non-clinical assistance — delivering water, adjusting lights, calling nurses, and providing entertainment.

applications.name: Disinfection
applications.description: UV-C equipped mobile robots autonomously disinfect patient rooms, operating theaters, and common areas. Validated 99.99% pathogen elimination.

applications.name: Pharmacy Automation
applications.description: CoBot arms handle medication picking, counting, and packaging in hospital pharmacies. Reduces medication errors and frees pharmacists for clinical duties.

warehousing_logistics.title: Warehousing & Logistics
warehousing_logistics.description: Automate your warehouse operations from receiving to shipping. Our AMRs and robotic systems handle goods movement, sorting, and order fulfillment with speed and accuracy.

applications.name: Goods-to-Person Picking
applications.description: CarryBot AMRs bring inventory shelves to pick stations, eliminating worker walking time. Increases pick rates from 80 to 300+ lines per hour.

applications.name: Cross-Docking & Sortation
applications.description: Autonomous robots sort incoming goods by destination at high speed. Reduces cross-dock processing time by 50%.

applications.name: Inventory Management
applications.description: SkyBot I1 drones perform automated inventory counts in high-bay racking using barcode scanning and computer vision. Counts 10× faster than manual methods.

applications.name: Last-Mile Delivery
applications.description: SkyBot D1 drones deliver small parcels within a 15 km radius. AutoHaul H1 autonomous vehicles handle larger deliveries on campus and between facilities.

smart_cities.title: Smart Cities & Public Infrastructure
smart_cities.description: Our robots contribute to safer, cleaner, and more efficient cities through autonomous inspection, security patrol, and public services.

applications.name: Infrastructure Inspection
applications.description: SkyBot I1 drones inspect bridges, tunnels, power lines, and buildings autonomously. AI detects cracks, corrosion, and structural issues early — preventing failures and reducing inspection costs by 70%.

applications.name: Security & Surveillance
applications.description: Autonomous mobile robots patrol public spaces, parking structures, and critical infrastructure. Anomaly detection AI alerts human operators to potential security threats.

applications.name: Public Information
applications.description: GuideBot G1 robots deployed in airports, train stations, and city centers provide wayfinding, event information, and multilingual assistance to citizens and tourists.

applications.name: Environmental Monitoring
applications.description: Sensor-equipped mobile robots monitor air quality, noise levels, and temperature across urban areas, providing real-time environmental data to city management systems.

agriculture.title: Agriculture & Agritech
agriculture.description: Precision agriculture powered by robotics and AI — from autonomous crop monitoring to selective harvesting.

applications.name: Crop Monitoring
applications.description: SkyBot I1 drones equipped with multispectral cameras survey crops, detecting disease, nutrient deficiency, and water stress before they become visible to the human eye.

applications.name: Autonomous Weeding & Spraying
applications.description: Mobile robots with computer vision identify and remove weeds mechanically or apply targeted spraying — reducing herbicide use by up to 90%.

applications.name: Harvesting Assistance
applications.description: CoBot arms with soft grippers and vision systems selectively harvest fruits and vegetables without damage. Adaptable to multiple crop types.
